sequence.title: Viltrumite Fury
sequence.objective: Thragg's extended physical showcase AND investigation; door one (Infinity off as bait); Gojo's smile fades.
sequence.logic: Each exchange follows from the last. E1 (S4-01..03): Thragg abandons straight lines for verticals, flanks and feints, grabs instead of punches, and never stays in reach; Gojo blocks nothing, sways off the one hook he reads late, and counters with two short Blues that Thragg beats by watching the hand (he learns: move when the hand moves; Gojo learns: he won't stay still for a point-blank Red). E2 (S4-04): the slow-hand test proves the barrier judges what he is, not his speed. E3 (S4-05..08): so Thragg attacks the one thing that changed (the uncovered eyes) with dust; the fist from the murk still hangs, but Gojo must spend his big Blue to see again, and Thragg punches through its rubble. E4 (S4-09..10): the full-force roof strike tests shockwave transmission; the wave parts round Gojo and the city takes it, tearing the cloud deck (the cause of Seq 7's light shafts). E5 (S4-11..12): Gojo, unable to fix a hit-and-run fighter in the open, pulls himself into the unfinished tower; Thragg follows through its flank, and the fighters swap sides on screen. E6 (S4-13..16): door one: Gojo switches Infinity off as bait (Hanami precedent G2-11); Thragg commits and stays, breaks the collarbone and drives the spear-hand; Infinity returns at high output (X1-14), pries the grip open and stalls the spear-hand; a point-blank Red cracks two ribs and burns his chest (R6 dose), guts three floors and blasts him west out of the tower into open sky, while Gojo pushes off his chest and tumbles out of the east face. Sky (S4-17..18): Thragg stabilises first and watches RCT knit the bone: 'So. It is a choice.' He now knows the barrier can be off and that damage must be total. End (S4-19..20): Gojo's smile fades; Thragg attacks again. Technique count: two short counter-Blues (E1) and one self-pull (E5) per the beat sheet, plus the ledger's one large dust-clearing Blue; Infinity off for 60 frames of real time (2.5 s; the 02 ledger's ≈0.4 s is logged for correction) then raised output; Red x1 point-blank; RCT x1.
sequence.music_cue: 140 BPM taiko/toms, driving ostinato, both motifs in counterpoint from the launch (S4-01); thinned under the slow-hand test and the dust stall; peak at the tower crash (S4-12); bare under the bait; hit on the Red; ducked under Thragg's line; music drops out for the smile-fades close-up (S4-19); a stinger on Thragg's launch hands into Seq 5.

shots.prompt_core: High-angle shot looking steeply down onto a ruined dusk intersection. A tall white-haired man in a black high-collared uniform, blindfold hanging at his neck, stands on cracked asphalt, eyes calmly raised to the face above him. A massive man in a torn white-and-crimson bodysuit plunges head-first from the top of frame, enormous in foreshortening, right hand open and reaching for the high collar; the fingers have stopped two centimetres short and hang there, curled, grit suspended in a thin halo between them and the collar, a faint refraction ripple in the gap. A ring of dust and paper lies flattened outward around the standing man's shoes. As his two fingers begin to rise, the big man is already swinging away past his flank; only then does a small white-blue point bloom on empty air, catching nothing but grit.

tactical.learned: Thragg: the pull arrives a beat after the hand moves, so move when the hand moves. Gojo: he left before the Blue existed.

shots.prompt_core: Worm's-eye view from cracked asphalt looking up at a tall white-haired man in a black high-collared uniform standing on empty air three metres above a ruined dusk avenue, blindfold at his neck, loose white hair. A massive man in a torn white-and-crimson bodysuit, shredded cape rags streaming, has come up from below: his open left hand hangs frozen three centimetres under the standing man's jaw, gravel suspended beneath the chin. He rolls behind him and hooks at the temple; the white-haired man sways back a hand's breadth and it misses clean. The white-haired man's hand flicks, but the big man is already gone: a small white-blue point blooms on empty air, bending a lamp post, and the view snaps in on him hovering twenty metres away, cold eyes fixed on the white-haired man's hands.

tactical.intent: Thragg: attack the levels Gojo cannot watch at once (a feint, then under, then the upstage flank) and leave before any counter.

tactical.outcome: The grab hangs, the hook misses clean, and the Blue blooms on empty air. Nothing lands either way.
tactical.learned: Gojo: he is reading my hands, and he won't stay still long enough for a point-blank Red. Thragg: break off whenever the hand moves; and again, he dodged.

Screen-right, a massive man in a torn white-and-crimson bodysuit with a split lip and shredded crimson cape rags floats in close at walking pace, right arm extended, palm open, reaching for the high collar; his fingers have stopped four centimetres short and hang there, a faint heat-haze refraction around the fingertips, nothing else between them.
